label: Bucket eviction policy
type: the memory-cache eviction strategy a bucket uses when it fills up. Configurable for Couchbase buckets; ephemeral buckets are stated to NOT support changing it via couchbase-cli bucket-edit, despite bucket-create describing it as available for both bucket types.
evidence: The memory-cache eviction policy for this bucket. This option is valid for Couchbase and Ephemeral buckets only.
The memory-cache eviction policy for this bucket. This option is valid for Couchbase buckets only; the eviction policy for ephemeral buckets...
note: The create-time vs. edit-time wording genuinely differs (create: valid for Couchbase AND Ephemeral; edit: valid for Couchbase only) - filed as docs-issues/server-bucket-eviction-policy-create-edit-scope-mismatch rather than resolved by inference, since both readings are plausible (ephemeral eviction policy fixed at creation and uneditable thereafter, or a genuine doc gap).
relates_to_competency_question: Can an ephemeral bucket's eviction policy be changed after creation?
